build.how: next build, then next start (production), the design harness env

environment.runtime: storefront pages and /api/cart on the edge runtime (Next's local edge sandbox, not Vercel's)
environment.databases: local sqld over http://127.0.0.1, one per database (platform, tenant, env default)

method.order: warm runs go round the routes in turn, one request at a time, over one kept-alive connection
method.cold: a fresh next start per route, then that route's first request on a new connection
method.ttfb: from sending the request to receiving the response headers
method.total: from sending the request to the last byte of the body
method.percentile: nearest rank (p95 of 50 runs is the 48th fastest)
method.bytes: response body as sent (gzip when offered), median; headers counted apart; firstVisitStatic is the /_next/static files the HTML names, fetched once each
method.db: counted on the wire by a proxy in front of each sqld (scripts/perf-dbcount.js) and checked against sqld's own query counter; warm = the middle counted run, first = the first request that route's code served after next start (collection-all shares its code with collection, and cart-update with cart-get, so theirs is already warm); rowsRead is sqld's own rows_read; bytesDown is the database's answers as sent (sqld gzips them when the client asks), bytesDownDecoded what the page had to parse
method.shopper: no cookies except the cart cookie on the cart and checkout routes, so the home page sees a first-time visitor; each request carries its own x-forwarded-for

notMeasured: Edge memory: Next's local edge sandbox runs inside one Node process, so no per-request or per-isolate memory figure exists locally. It needs the hosted runtime (OQ-19).
Hosted latency: Turso and the hosted edge add network time between the page and its database; here every database call stays on this Mac.
Images: product and page photos (/_next/image, /api/media) are not fetched.
budgets: None. Budgets wait for hosted numbers (PERF-04, OQ-19). These local numbers are a baseline, not a budget.
